description: Sandbox family (crates/twig-fuzz/src/gen/sandbox.rs): minimised mismatches between twig-rs and Twig 3.31.1 on PHP 8.5.13, one root cause per reason: A numeric policy class keys, B security errors of names first used at line 0, C {% deprecated %} argument types, D null-safe array keys with the sandbox extension, E nested null-safe chains under ?? with wrapped operands, F a twig-test-support port, G strict defined tests of inner null-safe chains. Hand-reduced repros first, then toolkit-minimised fuzz cases (minimized-*). Recorded with "isolation": "process".
